title: UAAP: La Salle survives UE in OT as second round begins

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Defending champion La Salle needed five more minutes to fend off winless University of the East, 97-88, in overtime at the start of the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball second round on Wednesday at Mall of Asia Arena. Tied at 80 with 3:21 remaining, the Green Archers went on a 17-6 surge to close out the pesky Red Warriors and snap a two-game skid. Mason Amos led La Salle (4-4) with 17 points and nine rebounds, while Henry Agunanne had 13 points, seven rebounds and three blocks.
